responsibility: This definition module exposes the generated parser entry point for mc pass 2. The compilation driver calls its CompilationUnit routine to perform the second parse that enriches the AST and symbol tables with type-equivalence and enumeration information established by mcp2.bnf.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is just the interface declaration for the generated mcp2 parser, exporting CompilationUnit; unlike mcp2.bnf, it contains none of the second-pass grammar or type/enumeration semantic actions.
